text.active_session_note: No active or paused session. Next step: the initial diagnostic, unless a test is explicitly requested.
text.c_active_session: ID of the open or paused session
text.c_age: only if the learner gives it
text.c_closing_saved: after Finish-Practice is saved and reread
text.c_counter: last number used per language; only grows, never reset
text.c_default_language: target language used when none is given (Set-Default language)
text.c_default_missions: mission used per language when none is given (Set-Default mission)
text.c_lab_missing_accepted: only if the learner accepted starting without the video
text.c_lab_off_range: required if what will be watched is outside 30–50% of the practice
text.c_lab_result: only if the learner does the Lab
text.c_lab_search_evidence: only with source search: the result used (link, title, channel, duration)
text.c_lab_suggested: when the Lab was suggested right after the closing
text.c_lab_verified_at: date and time the saved record was reread
text.c_lab_video_minutes: minutes or mm:ss; unconfirmed only with source search
text.c_mission_description: scenario and context, in the learner's words
text.c_mission_diagnostic: regular diagnostic session the mission is based on
text.c_mission_id_key: short, kebab-case, unique in the language; also the file name
text.c_mission_target_date: DD/MM/YYYY, required: when the learner wants to be ready
text.c_mission_title: what the learner wants to get ready for
text.c_native_language: language of every message, folder, file and record in this Central
text.c_root: local path or Drive/OneDrive folder ID
text.c_situation: mission situation practiced in this session
text.c_voice_ids: announce phrase numbers in voice mode
text.central_state_note: Fill in only after a real setup. Never copy progress between learners.
text.closing_note: Outcome, evidence-based feedback, limitations, next task and progress update status.
text.col_can_do: What the learner needs to be able to do
text.current_profile_note: No assessment completed yet. Sources: the diagnostic and the progress log of this language. Never infer CEFR levels without evidence.
text.diag_stage_2: Speaking and interaction: evidence, confidence, provisional CEFR
text.diag_stage_3: Everyday and technical reading: evidence, confidence, provisional CEFR
text.diag_stage_4: Feedback: priorities, limitations and goals for the next 14 days
text.diag_stage_5: Closing: saved, reread and next step
text.diagnostic_note: Never invent scores or judge pronunciation from a transcript alone.
text.history_note: Verified periodic summaries and references to archived cycles. Tests never count as real practices.
text.lab_note: Prepared and verified before stage 1. The Lab has no status of its own; it is part of the practice.
text.last_turn_note: Last turn, pending step and next question.
text.mission_practices_note: One row per practice session of this mission, added when the session is created. Status: In progress (prepared), In progress (running), In progress (paused) or Completed. A practice deleted by Reset-Practices leaves this table.
text.phrase_index_title: Phrase index (global F numbers for this language; never reused)
text.recent_context_note: No real practices yet. Use the diagnostic to set priorities and observed difficulties.
text.roadmap_title: Roadmap (the practice is completed when stages 0–6 are done; stage 7 is the optional Lab, suggested right after the closing)
text.situations_note: Example: 1 Airport · 2 Immigration · 3 Public transport · 4 Restaurants. The next practice works on the situation the learner chooses or, if none, the first situation with the fewest completed practices.
text.stage_0: Lab material ready and reread before stage 1 (or learner accepted starting without the video)
text.stage_7: Entertainment Lab suggested after the closing (optional)
text.val_missions: None yet (each mission has its own target date)
text.val_next_review: To be scheduled after the diagnostic
text.val_next_step: Complete the initial diagnostic before the first regular practice.
text.val_status: No diagnostic or real practices recorded yet
